text:
Alex: FYI Quell Dynamics just offered a 3-week preview of their SpectrumEdge v1 appliance for us to run an inference + SI integration pass. They require an internal NDA and a short partner feedback form. Want someone to pick this up and coordinate cloud marketplace packaging considerations. cc @Hannah @Ops :wave:

Hannah: I can take engineering + harnessing. We should decide targets: 8B low-latency, 30B medium-context (12k), and a smoke run for 70B if the appliance advertises it. Also we need to confirm marketplace-ready image requirements (OCI vs AMI) so Product can prep the listing draft.

Quell-Rep: Hi team  we will provide an appliance image (OCI tarball), per-step power CSVs, a small telemetry JSON schema, and SSH creds for our lab. NDA is vendor-supplied; please note embargo clause about joint press. We can share marketplace metadata spec.

Alex: Great. Ops, can you reserve sandbox nodes the week of 2024-04-15? We'll need network isolation and a testable AMI/OCI conversion path. Also mark this as "marketplace candidate" so PM can start a draft listing.

Ops: Reservation done: sandbox-spectrumedge-0415 (3 nodes). Uploaded to s3://quell-preview/spectrumedge-v1.oci (20.2G). Noted marketplace flag and assigned an internal PR to product for listing draft.

Hannah: Bench matrix (draft):
- 8B: 4k context, p50/p90/p99, tokens/sec, mem high-water
- 30B: 12k context, sustained throughput, KV cache hit ratio
- 70B: smoke (sanity only) if OOMs allowed
Target deliverable: embargoed numbers by 2024-04-20. We'll include both raw CSVs and a short narrative for the embargoed summary.

DSP-Bot: artifact uploaded: spectrumedge-v1-20240410.oci (20.2G) to s3://quell-preview/artifacts/ and triggered image-verify job #4821.

Hannah: Telemetry plan: post power CSVs and telemetry JSON to our S3 bucket, and also POST to Quell's ingest endpoint for parity checking. Example envs:
```
export QUELL_TELEM=https://telem.quell/api/ingest
export REDWOOD_TOKEN=redwood-market-xxxx
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" -d @payload.json $QUELL_TELEM
```
We'll gate any external submission on Legal sign-off.

Quell-Rep: We can accept both methods. We'll also upload power CSVs named with ISO timestamps and a sample JSON schema. We'll give product the marketplace metadata template (AMI/OCI requirements + icons + copy).

Legal: NDA reminder: internal evaluation only. Any external figure or marketplace listing copy must be approved by Quell at least 72 hours before publishing. I'll add an embargo checklist and required review step in the repo. Also check export-control flags on the appliance firmware; send to legal@redwood for review.

Hannah: Ill start wiring the harness and include a conversion step for OCI->AMI just in case. Run snippet for sanity check:
```
./run_infer --model redwood/30b-12k --seq 12288 --warm 200 --iters 300
```
I'll post logs to https://git.redwood/integration/spectrumedge/runbook.md and pin the image link.

Alex: Product, please draft an embargoed marketplace listing skeleton (no benchmark figures) so Quell can review copy and assets early. Also coordinate joint announcement timing if partner wants co-announcement.

Quell-Rep: We'll review the draft listing and coordinate a joint press playbook if results look good. We'll provide a short partner feedback survey to be completed after runs.

Ops: Sync scheduled Tue 09:00 PT. Agenda: access creds, telemetry schema, OCI->AMI conversion, bench matrix, legal embargo checklist, marketplace draft. Invite sent to Quell.

Hannah: Slot works. I'll upload pre-reads and the eval packs to the repo today. If Quell can share recommended driver/firmware combos, please drop them into the runbook.

Legal: I'll upload the NDA and embargo checklist now. Reminder: any external metrics require explicit partner approval before publishing.

Quell-Rep: Uploading tokens, sample payloads, and power CSV samples tomorrow. Looking forward to the integration. :rocket:
